name: LeMoyne-Owen College
tuition_note: Official Cost/Tuition page (loc.edu/admissions/financial-aid-2/cost/, 'Tuition Update Fall 2026') publishes tuition ONLY as a per-credit rate: $472 per credit hour (plus Student Activity Fee $125, Student Health Fee $200, Books $25.50/credit); no flat full-time or annual tuition & fees total is published, so in_state_tuition is null rather than a computed guess. Private/independent HBCU (single rate for all students). Housing: page lists 'Housing (double-occupancy, per semester) $1,800' = $3,600/year room only (2 semesters); meal plan/board listed separately at $1,320/semester and NOT included in housing_cost.
